result.question: Who fell at the hands of David and his servants in Gath?

readings.answer: The four descendants of Rapha in Gath
readings.support: these four descendants of Rapha in Gath

assessments.reason: Verse 21:22 explicitly says, “these four descendants of Rapha in Gath fell at the hands of David and his servants,” matching the key’s “Four descendants of Rapha.”

result.reason: The text states that four descendants of Rapha in Gath fell at the hands of David and his servants.
